violation_type.title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))
violation_type.short_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not had required posting for emergency and evaluation relocation diagram posted during the application inspection.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not had required posting for emergency and evaluation relocation diagram posted during the application inspection.
Four classrooms that are currently being used by students were missing the evacuation route posted.
Room #2, #6, and #7 did not have a relocation  diagram posted in clas
One classroom did not have its evacuation plan poste and there was no snack menu posted.
The evacuation plan was not posted in either classroom.

There were two classrooms that did not have the emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted (2 year old & 3 year old).      This was corrected during the inspection when the emergency diagrams were posted in each of the classrooms.
